definitions: A game played on a large open-air course with 9 or 18 holes, whose object is to strike a small hard ball with a club into a series of 9 or 18 successive holes on the course, using as few strokes as possible.
A type of small, hard ball used in the game of golf.
A type of club used in the game of golf.
examples: He enjoys a round of golf every weekend.
The golf landed in the water hazard.
She chose a new golf for her shot.
